Tesseract OCR for reading photos and scanned PDFs of reports on the user's device.

- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE)
- tesseract-core-*.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0), Tesseract OCR engine
- eng.traineddata.gz: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int model (Apache-2.0)

Loaded only when someone adds a photo or a scanned PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
